name: 中国剪纸
author: TO DO
description: 传统中国剪纸：单张纸刀刻、线线相连、镂空纹样、纯平面无光影。用中文描述主体即可。

inputs.label: 画面主体
inputs.placeholder: 例如：一条衔着灯笼的锦鲤，周围有浪花

options.label: 中国红
options.prompt: cut from a single sheet of solid vermilion red paper, one flat red color only

options.label: 红金
options.prompt: cut from solid vermilion red paper with a few thin gold paper accents layered behind, only red and gold

options.label: 墨黑
options.prompt: cut from a single sheet of solid black paper, one flat black color only

options.label: 彩色套色
options.prompt: multi-layer colored paper-cut in traditional folk colors (red, yellow, green, blue), each color a flat paper layer

options.label: 单体居中
options.prompt: a single isolated motif centered in the frame with generous empty margin around it

options.label: 圆形团花
options.prompt: composed inside a circular medallion (tuanhua), radially symmetric decorative border

options.label: 方形窗花
options.prompt: square window-flower (chuanghua) composition with a decorative square border and corner ornaments

options.label: 横幅
options.prompt: wide horizontal banner composition, motif repeated or extended left to right

options.label: 纯白底
options.prompt: placed on a pure flat white background, nothing else in the background

options.label: 宣纸底
options.prompt: placed on a plain off-white rice paper background with very subtle paper fiber texture

prompt.template: Traditional Chinese paper-cut art (jianzhi) depicting {{subject}}. {{layout}}. The artwork is {{palette}}. Hand-cut with a knife: every line is continuous and connected to the rest of the paper, intricate hollow-out patterns with classic sawtooth and crescent-moon cut motifs, bold graphic silhouettes, folk-art stylization. Strictly flat 2D, viewed straight on, no perspective, no gradients, no shading, no lighting effects, no depth, crisp clean cut edges. {{background}}.
